gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same covariance-ODE defect: the second drift factor must be transposed, producing the order \Sigma_t\mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t rather than \Sigma_tP_t\mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1}. It explicitly connects the incorrect order to loss of symmetry in the noncommuting case and gives the corrected formula.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the use of P_t\mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1} in the second covariance drift factor instead of the transpose \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t, making the stated covariance ODE invalid when the matrices do not commute.

component_coverage.gold_component: The Gaussian-moments covariance ODE uses the wrong transpose/order in its cross-term, so it is false and can fail symmetry for noncommuting covariance and preconditioner matrices.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction derives the covariance identity with A^T, states that A^T contains \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t rather than P_t\mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1}, explains the resulting nonsymmetry when the matrices fail to commute, and supplies the corrected second term.
